name: cachety
description: Watermark ID documents and other files privately, in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
author: Amir Moradi (https://amirmoradi.com)

scripts.assets: mkdir -p public/pdfjs && cp -r node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm node_modules/pdfjs-dist/iccs node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs public/pdfjs/ && bun run scripts/fonts.mjs
scripts.postbuild: bun run scripts/seo.ts && bun run scripts/gen-sw.mjs
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name cachety --branch main
